rules.symbol_mapping: Only CCXT BASE/USDT:USDT symbols are accepted and map exactly to Binance BASEUSDT archive symbols.
rules.membership_binding: Every evaluation day uses only the eligible symbols in its immutable prior-UTC-day activation-lock binding.
required_files: one-minute klines for each eligible symbol on the membership day
one-minute klines for each eligible symbol on the evaluation day
aggregate trades for each eligible symbol on the evaluation day
rules.inventory_policy: Duplicate, missing, or extra dataset-symbol-day entries reject the entire phase before paths are exposed.
rules.byte_policy: Every file is reverified against the publisher checksum, exact filename, single ZIP member, CSV schema, and manifest digest before use.
rules.midnight_policy: When a symbol is included on adjacent evaluation days, its aggregate-trade ID must continue exactly across the UTC-day seam.
rules.membership_gap_policy: Aggregate-trade continuity is not inferred across a day on which the symbol was not eligible and therefore had no authorized archive.

unchanged: exactly one preceding kline day for the first 720-minute causal lookback
